"PREMIER PLAY" has three of three top prizes left and is near the start of its run. Only a small slice of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Everything above about "PREMIER PLAY" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2414.headline: Tickets sold so far

2415.body:
"Double The Money" is in the middle of its run, with about half of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "Double The Money" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2415.headline: Early stage or late

2416.body:
"Loaded with $2,000s" has 1,279 of 3,372 top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About two-thirds of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The table below shows the full count for "Loaded with $2,000s", with every prize level included.
2416.headline: How far along this game is

2419.body:
A $2,777 top prize on "Bronze 7s" was claimed two weeks ago. The game started with four top prizes and has one top prize left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Every line of Bronze 7s's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2419.headline: A top prize was just claimed

2420.body:
"Silver 7s" has gone two weeks without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $177,777 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Everything here about "Silver 7s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 5.
2420.headline: No top prize claimed lately

2421.body:
"Gold 7s" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $577,777 was claimed last week. Unsold tickets still hold one of the original three. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

If "Gold 7s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2421.headline: Another top prize was claimed

2422.body:
"Platinum 7s" offers a top prize of $2 million and eleven prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward small, frequent prizes. Games shaped like this pay small prizes often and large prizes rarely. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

If you play "Platinum 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2422.headline: How this game pays out

2426.body:
About half of the tickets for "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" have been sold. The game is in the middle of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Everything here about "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 5.
2426.headline: Tickets sold so far

2427.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "HOLIDAY TRIPLER", nearly all are still unsold. The game is still new, with 583 of 602 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If "HOLIDAY TRIPLER" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2427.headline: Tickets sold so far

2428.body:
"PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" just went on sale in Virginia. The game has twelve full prize levels with five top prizes of $25,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

The numbers for "PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2428.headline: New in stores

2429.body:
"MERRY MONEY TREE" has joined the Virginia lineup at $5 with four top prizes of $125,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Everything here about "MERRY MONEY TREE" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 5.
2429.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

2430.body:
"WRAPPED IN RICHES" has joined the Virginia lineup at $10 with three top prizes of $500,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

The table below shows the full count for "WRAPPED IN RICHES", with every prize level included.
